en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small pavilion-like spring building with a steep metal roof topped by a finial and flag, labeled "ANTICA FONTE PEJO". It is set between multi‑story Alpine-style buildings (one marked "HOTEL OLIVA") in a mountain valley. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand in front of the spring building. There is printed caption text in the lower right corner and handwritten script along the bottom margin.
